sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: A digital home for learning rooted in the Himalaya.
body: Studio 1947 is working with the Sikkim Himal Institute across design and technology. This portfolio layout is a visual framework for the identity, digital experience and institutional story; detailed project content can be added as the engagement progresses.

sections.heading: Learning, Research and Place in One Experience
sections.label: Website Mockup
body: The responsive website concept brings programmes, research and events into a calm editorial system shaped by the institute's Himalayan context. It is presented as a design mockup, ready to be replaced or expanded with final screens and content.

media.alt: Concept mockup of the Sikkim Himal Institute website on a laptop and smartphone

sections.heading: An Identity System Made to Travel
sections.label: Brand Application Mockup
body: The existing emblem and wordmark are extended across a restrained set of institutional touchpoints. The mockup creates a visual stage for the final stationery, course material, credentials and field documentation.

media.alt: Concept mockup of Sikkim Himal Institute stationery, notebook, folder and identity card
